specTitle: Test Case 1: Navigate to UD Loans Payment Guide page via Loan Payment Guides dropdown
title: AC1: Navigate to Loan Payment Guides Page and select UD Loans
preconditions: User is on the UnionDigital Bank homepage (https://uniondigitalbank.io/en)
steps:
1. Navigate to https://uniondigitalbank.io/en
2. Click on 'Loan Payment Guides' nav item
3. Click on 'UD Loans' link in the dropdown
expected: UD Loans Payment Guide page is displayed at https://uniondigitalbank.io/en/guides-ud-loans

specTitle: Test Case 1: Verify '+' expand icon is visible on UD Loans Payment Guide accordion
title: ED-74 AC1: Validate Expand Option - '+' icon visible on 'How To Pay Your UD Loans'
preconditions: User navigates directly to the UD Loans Payment Guide page (https://uniondigitalbank.io/en/guides-ud-loans)
steps:
1. Navigate to https://uniondigitalbank.io/en/guides-ud-loans
2. Verify the page heading 'UD LOANS PAYMENT GUIDES' is visible
3. Locate the accordion item 'How To Pay Your UD Loans'
4. Verify the accordion button is in collapsed state (aria-expanded='false')
5. Verify the '+' icon is displayed to the right of 'How To Pay Your UD Loans' text
expected: The accordion item 'How To Pay Your UD Loans' is visible and its expand button has aria-expanded='false', confirming the '+' icon is rendered on the right side of the text

specTitle: Test Case 1: Verify 'Click here to pay via UPAY' link is visible under the UPAY payment section
title: ED-76 AC1: Validate UPAY Link - 'Click here to pay via UPAY' link is visible under UPAY section
preconditions: User is on the UD Loans Payment Guide page (https://uniondigitalbank.io/en/guides-ud-loans) with payment option details displayed (accordion expanded)
steps:
1. Navigate to https://uniondigitalbank.io/en/guides-ud-loans
2. Click the 'How To Pay Your UD Loans' accordion button to expand payment options
3. Scroll to the 'Pay through your other bank accounts or e-wallets via UPAY.' section
4. Observe the 'Click here to pay via UPAY' link below the UPAY section heading
expected: 'Click here to pay via UPAY' link is displayed and visible under the 'Pay through your other bank accounts or e-wallets via UPAY.' section

specTitle: Test Case 1: Verify Free UnionBank payment options section is visible
title: ED-77 AC1: Verify 'Free UnionBank payment options' section is displayed on Loan Payment page
preconditions: User is on the UD Loans Payment Guide page (https://uniondigitalbank.io/en/guides-ud-loans) with the 'How To Pay Your UD Loans' accordion expanded
steps:
1. Navigate to https://uniondigitalbank.io/en/guides-ud-loans
2. Click the 'How To Pay Your UD Loans' accordion button to expand payment options
3. Observe the '1. Free UnionBank payment options' section heading in the accordion panel
expected: '1. Free UnionBank payment options' section text is visible in the expanded accordion panel

specTitle: Test Case 2: Verify UPAY payment section is visible on Loan Payment page
title: ED-77 AC2: Verify 'Pay through your other bank accounts or e-wallets via UPAY' section is displayed on Loan Payment page
preconditions: User is on the UD Loans Payment Guide page (https://uniondigitalbank.io/en/guides-ud-loans) with the 'How To Pay Your UD Loans' accordion expanded
steps:
1. Navigate to https://uniondigitalbank.io/en/guides-ud-loans
2. Click the 'How To Pay Your UD Loans' accordion button to expand payment options
3. Observe the '2. Pay through your other bank accounts or e-wallets via UPAY.' section heading in the accordion panel
expected: '2. Pay through your other bank accounts or e-wallets via UPAY.' section text is visible in the expanded accordion panel

specTitle: Test Case 1: Click PAY VIA UPAY NOW and verify UD Loans payment page is displayed
title: ED-78 AC1: Initiate UPAY Payment - clicking PAY VIA UPAY NOW displays UD Loans by UnionDigital Bank Payment Page
preconditions: User is on the Loan Payment page (https://loans.uniondigitalbank.io/LoanPayment)
steps:
1. Navigate to https://loans.uniondigitalbank.io/LoanPayment
2. Locate the 'PAY VIA UPAY NOW' button under the 'Pay through your other bank accounts or e-wallets via UPAY.' section
3. Click the 'PAY VIA UPAY NOW' button
4. Observe the resulting page
expected: The URL changes to https://loans.uniondigitalbank.io/LoanPayment/UPay and the heading 'UD Loans by UnionDigital Bank Payment Page' is displayed on the page

specTitle: Test Case 1: Verify Loan Number and Payment Amount text boxes are displayed on UD Loans Payment Page
title: ED-79 AC1: Validate Payment Page Fields - Loan Number and Payment Amount text boxes are displayed
preconditions: User has navigated to the UD Loans by UnionDigital Bank Payment Page (https://loans.uniondigitalbank.io/LoanPayment/UPay) by clicking 'PAY VIA UPAY NOW' on the Loan Payment landing page
steps:
1. Navigate to https://loans.uniondigitalbank.io/LoanPayment
2. Click the 'PAY VIA UPAY NOW' button
3. Verify the URL changes to https://loans.uniondigitalbank.io/LoanPayment/UPay
4. Verify the 'Loan Number' text box is visible
5. Verify the 'Payment Amount' text box is visible
expected: Both 'Loan Number' and 'Payment Amount' text boxes are visible and editable on the 'UD Loans by UnionDigital Bank Payment Page'
